title: Statichost.eu – European static site hosting
why_read: A niche EU-based static hosting service launch, useful mainly for those specifically seeking GDPR-compliant infrastructure alternatives.
analysis: This is a Show-HN style launch of a European static site hosting provider, likely positioned around GDPR compliance and data sovereignty rather than novel technology. Static hosting is a well-solved problem with many competitors (Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages), so the differentiation here is jurisdictional rather than technical. Still, some engineers building for EU markets may find it a useful option to know about.
